title: Round623: hidden bench-set privacy during live turns

mutation.members: Opponent's fifth and sixth team members, which are not selected by team 1234.

method: For each opponent team, create a baseline and a hidden-bench variant with the same seed. Select the same four Pokémon. At every live decision, compare the full player-visible protocol log and Tracker.view, choose a random action from the baseline using only its player request flags, then apply the same joint choice to both battles.
scope_limit: Sampled random-choice trajectories only. Because only unrevealed bench sets were changed, this does not certify active Pokémon hidden sets, every midgame event, all mechanics, or all hidden-world assumptions.
next: Add the Tracker.world-based Ninjask simulator as an optional sampling backend behind player-view-only inputs, then compare full decision latency and paired playing strength against the Showdown search path.
